Museum and Study Centre of the Greek Theatre (Μουσείο Μελέτης Ελληνικού Θεάτρου)
A low but imposing building erected between 1882 and 1890 by architect Ernst Ziller in the eclectic style of that age, commissioned by King George I.

This is the largest and most popular of Athens' many museums, and is usually very crowded. Its vast collection includes treasures unearthed from Mycenae by Heinrich Schliemann; a staggering array of sculpture including the earliest…
Paintings of Greek painters of the first half of the 20th century are displayed.
Covers 27.7 hectares, near the National Archaeological Museum.
